notes: Inventory of every surface and interaction of put.gd for acceptance coverage. Kinds: button, menu-item, field, key, shortcut, gesture, state, cli, mcp, event, edge. `control` names an objectName (or text:LABEL, text-glob:PATTERN, glob:NAME-PATTERN, class:QtClass; one or a list) in the surface's catalog capture; `keys` are Qt portable key names; `method` is the resident method; `to` is the surface the interaction leads to. Visual applies unless `visual` is false (cli and mcp default to false). Desktop rows name every planned builder placement, not a single inferred host. Hostless v1 coverage stays unspecified. Cinnamon guests use the Mint cinnamon-x11 golden. Ubuntu GNOME VM rows on k72/aurora-amd include both session profiles; provision/verify the selected profile before acceptance.
